title: Speed up environmental approvals for priority projects
action: Set up a specialist team in the federal environment department to assess priority clean energy projects, appoint an independent Coordinator-General to track and unblock approvals across governments, and at the next review consider whether the Act should give the energy transition more weight.
why: Slow approvals delay investment in new energy supply and housing, raising costs; faster, better-resourced assessment keeps environmental protections while cutting delay.

evidence.source: Investing in cheaper, cleaner energy and the net zero transformation: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: The Australian Government agency responsible for approvals under the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999 (Cth) should establish a strike team to assess priority renewable energy projects.

evidence.source: Investing in cheaper, cleaner energy and the net zero transformation: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: The Australian Government should appoint within a central agency an independent infrastructure Coordinator-General.
